hypothesis: In gamma-only cache mode gamma is loaded once per block but bias is streamed once per row batch. Ranking candidates by tile count alone can choose a smaller tile with more bias rereads. Counting gamma tiles once plus bias tiles per batch may reduce total parameter tile traffic. No runtime gain is assumed.

change.scope: resident-parameter candidate ranking for FP32 and BF16 gamma-only cache modes
change.behavior: Add an optional streamed-bias cost to ChooseWideFullYRows. Gamma-only calls rank by tileCount * (1 + batchCount); all full-parameter-cache calls retain tile-count-first ranking.

static_reachability.condition: The existing selector chooses a gamma-only cache candidate; gamma is resident once per block while bias remains streamed per batch.
static_reachability.cost_model: gammaTileCount + biasTileCount * candidateBatchCount; both parameter vectors use the same tile count.
